title: Information-Geometric Quantum Process Tomography in Unital Open Single-Qubit Dynamics
summary: We derive an exact information-geometric inequality valid for both Markovian and non-Markovian mixed-state dynamics. This inequality saturates into a strict equality for single qubits because they belong to the quantum exponential family. This identity enables a non-iterative linear regression approach to continuous-time quantum process tomography, which, provided the full-rank condition is satisfied, yields a unique global solution and avoids local minima traps typical of standard non-linear optimization.
